metadata.title: JWC · Personal Training Berlin
metadata.description: Personal training in Berlin and online for people who are serious: build muscle, lose fat, stay consistent.

hero.subtitle: Personal training in Berlin and online. For people who want to build muscle, lose fat and finally stay consistent.

about.heading: ABOUT ME
about.description: I'm Jess, a personal trainer from Berlin. I played for years for ALBA Berlin in the youth Bundesliga and then at a prep school in the USA. Today I'm Head Coach at RISMO Fitness and athletic coach of the Moabit Lions.
about.description2: Competitive sport taught me that results come from structure, technique and progression. Motivation helps you start, consistency gets you there. That is exactly how I coach you.

goals.title: Finally build up
goals.text: You feel too skinny, you train, and still nothing changes? It's rarely genetics. It's usually the plan and the nutrition. You get both: strength training with clear progression and a nutrition plan that helps you gain on purpose, focused on muscle rather than just weight.
items: Strength training with progression, clean technique from day one
Nutrition plan for building: calories and protein tailored to you
Regular check-ins: weight, strength numbers, photos

goals.title: Lose fat, gain muscle
goals.text: Just losing weight won't make you fit. We reduce fat while building or keeping muscle, with strength training and nutrition that fits your daily life. Whether it's booty goals, a defined upper body or simply getting back in shape.
items: Strength training instead of endless cardio
Nutrition without crash diets, built for everyday life
Measurable goals: measurements, strength numbers, photos

notFor.heading: Who it's not for
notFor.text: Honestly: my coaching isn't for you if you're looking for a quick fix or just want to try it out. It's for you if you're ready to stay consistent for at least 3 months. Age and fitness level don't matter, your mindset does.

whatMakesDifferent.heading: WHAT MAKES MY COACHING DIFFERENT
items: Individually tailored to you and your goal
Training in clear phases instead of random workouts
Technique, structure and progression instead of chaos
Background in athletics, strength training, functional training and basketball

items.question: How does the initial consultation work?
items.answer: In the initial consultation, we look at your goal, your current level and your circumstances together. This helps me better assess which offer makes the most sense for you and what the best start looks like.

items.question: Where does the training take place?
items.answer: 1:1 training takes place in Berlin, coaching is fully online. We'll agree on the exact location in the initial call.

items.question: How much is the trial session?
items.answer: €49. The amount is credited when you sign up for a membership.

items.question: Is there a minimum term?
items.answer: Starter spots run for at least 3 months. Regular memberships can be cancelled monthly after 3 months.

items.question: Do I get a nutrition plan too?
items.answer: Yes, in every membership and online from the Coaching tier up.

items.question: What's the difference between Plan and Coaching?
items.answer: With Plan you get a clear training plan tailored to you that you follow on your own. With Coaching you also get a nutrition plan, WhatsApp support, check-ins every 2 weeks and adjustments. That means you're not alone with your training and can ask questions any time.

items.question: Is the support for online offers completely digital?
items.answer: Yes. The support runs fully online via messages and, when needed, check-up calls. You train independently but get support, adjustments and feedback so you're not alone with your plan.

items.question: How quickly will I get a response?
items.answer: I typically respond within 10 hours. You can message me anytime when questions about your training, exercises or progress come up.

items.question: What if I don't know how to do an exercise?
items.answer: No problem. If you've booked Coaching, just message me. Depending on the situation I'll send you example videos, explanations or suitable alternatives. What matters is that you can do the exercises safely and with good form.

items.question: Can I switch from the training plan to personal training later?
items.answer: Yes, of course. If you feel you want more direct guidance, corrections or personal support, we can switch from Plan to 1:1 personal training or VIP at any time.

items.question: Who is VIP for?
items.answer: VIP is ideal if you want online coaching plus training in person with me twice a month.

items.question: How does the individual training plan work?
items.answer: You first book your package, then fill out a questionnaire and we have a short initial consultation. After that, I create your training plan — tailored to your goal, your level and your possibilities.

items.question: How quickly will I get my training plan?
items.answer: You'll usually receive your training plan within 3–5 days, often even faster.

items.question: Do I need to be fit already to work with you?
items.answer: No, of course not. Whether beginner or advanced, I meet you where you are. My coaching is designed to adapt to your level, your goal and your possibilities.

items.question: Can I start with a training plan even if I don't train at a gym yet?
items.answer: Yes. A training plan can also be designed so you can follow it at home or with minimal equipment.

section1.description1: I'm Jess, a personal trainer from Berlin. I played for years for ALBA Berlin in the youth Bundesliga and then at a prep school in the USA. Today I'm Head Coach at RISMO Fitness and athletic coach of the Moabit Lions.
section1.description2: I don't work with aimless training or short-term motivation — I work with structure, progression and coaching that truly fits you and your daily life.

section2.description1: I work with people who've started and stopped many times before. Who aren't lazy — but overwhelmed by plans that don't fit their life, and left alone with good intentions that disappear after two weeks.
section2.description2: My job isn't to yell you through a workout. My job is to build a training structure with you that holds up even when Tuesday gets stressful, your back hurts, or you haven't trained for three days.

section3.description1: Whether you want to get stronger, lose fat, improve your fitness or simply train consistently again — we'll build a path together that you can actually follow through on.
section3.description2: No standard plan. No "just push through." Instead, a system that fits your daily life, your body and your level — with someone who thinks along and stays on it.
